title: There Is a Time When Moments Flow
description: There Is a Time When Moments Flow in Tonic Solfa to UXBRIDGE, doh is E: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 960 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “Sabbath Evening”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Long Metre (8.8.8.8), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to UXBRIDGE; any other Long Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: There is a time when mo-ments flow More hap-pi-ly than all be-side; It is, of all the times be-low, A Sab-bath of the ev-en-tide.

lines: There is a time when moments flow
It is, of all the times below,
O then the setting sun shines fair,
And all below, and all above,
The various forms of Nature, wear
And then the peace that Jesus brought
The life of grace eternal beams,
And we, by his example taught,
Improve the life his love redeems.
Delightful scene! a world at rest;
A God all love; no grief, no fear;
A heavenly hope, a peaceful breast,
A smile, unsullied by a tear.
